Bite (d12) / Claws (d8). Fire Breath: Nearby area, 10 damage or 5 on a successful GRACE test. She does not want to fight.

Princess Amy of Drakenshire, trapped in the dragon Embra's body by swapped gnomish necklaces. Clumsy in the huge body; fiercely protective of Scamp the squirrel; speaks with a young girl's voice.

Her gift — Powerful Friendship — is the only force that can shatter the Barrier of Thorns. If she dies in this body, the barrier is permanent.
